known.via: English Wikipedia "Red Hills Lake County AVA"

climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A Lake County AVA of red, stony soils on rolling hills at the foot of Mount Konocti, beside Clear Lake. Elevations run from 1,400 to 3,000 feet. The county grows mostly Cabernet Sauvignon, then Sauvignon Blanc.
